rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the quality or appeal that makes someone or something attractive.

example.english: This movie has a lot of attractiveness.
example.traditional: 呢套戲嘅吸引力真係好大。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 kap1 jan5 lik6 zan1 hai6 hou2 daai6

rows.note: Use this for personal charm, charisma, or the distinctive appeal of a person, work, or style.

example.english: Their attractiveness really comes through when they speak.
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 jau5 mei6 lik6

rows.jyutping: kap1 jan5 jan4 ge3 dei6 fong1
rows.note: Use this when referring to a particular attractive feature or appealing aspect rather than attractiveness in general.

example.english: The attractiveness of this restaurant lies in its rooftop terrace.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳吸引人嘅地方係個露台。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 kap1 jan5 jan4 ge3 dei6 fong1 hai6 go3 lou6 toi4
